panels.text: The voice belongs to a young boy leaning against the glass of a spaceship observation deck, speaking as if this were an ordinary morning.
Cancer belongs mostly to history lessons. Ageing has slowed to a patient crawl. No living person remembers the last war, 247 years ago.
Below the deck, the Creation Halls feel like an unlimited universe in the basement: tools, rooms, objects, games, and ideas waiting to be made.
The Creation Halls can turn a useful idea into a safe prototype: an item, a room, a visual, a plan, or even a game.
Your PA floats beside you. Hundreds of related builder robots work throughout the ship, each with a different face, speciality, and identity.
The job is almost Santa-like: travel from world to world, fix what people ask you to fix, join their games, and leave something wonderful behind.
First destination: Luma Isle. The ship is ready when you are.
